$comment: How the factory gets contracts/. Read cloud/factory/CONTRACTS.md before editing. `bundleVersion` is the EXACT contracts/bundle.json version this package is built against — it is checked in every mode, so a fixture edit here without a bundle re-cut fails the build. `mode` is flipped to "pinned" by the repo-extraction phase; `files` is the set of contracts the factory's vitest suite imports and must equal it exactly.
